text: Antonio Molina is a ninth generation Lasombra and the sire of Carlos Griffouliere.
The Ashen Lady is a Deathlord of Stygia. In this case, she is the head of the Iron Legion, the division of the Hierarchy that commands the souls of those taken by old age.
Augusta Holford is a Setite agent with a remarkable talent for corruption.
An Atavism is one of the manifest Beasts of the Primal Wilds, embodying the Arcanum of Life, that can be called down by the use of Supernal Summoning.

A werewolf with the Gift of Assimilation blends smoothly into any culture, no matter how strange or unfamiliar he might normally find it. He could slip among Bedouin nomads as if he were one of them, or he could shop in a Chinese market without anyone noticing that he does not belong. The Gift doesn't hide racial differences, but it does allow the user to mimic the behaviors and mannerisms of a native. It also grants the ability to speak and understand the culture's language, although this knowledge vanishes as the Gift ends.
Asa Anderson is a Seelie Troll Wilder from the Isles of Caledonia.
Arundhati was a penanggal who posed as a pleasant girl to get into the good graces of potential victims.

Arthur Minturn was a mirror-crafter and serial killer who lived during the Victorian period. He would prey upon unwanted children, whom he had brought from London to his workshop in Llangollen, Wales. There, he would kill each child and soak his mirrors in their blood. Though his assumption that he could ritualistically extend his life through his murders so proved false, the mirrors were indeed altered by the operation. They tend to reflect the state of the Shadow, rather than the mortal world.
Atlacoya is a tenth generation Gangrel and the sire of Duncan MacTavish.
Aurora was a Lasombra and the Scourge of the Los Angeles Camarilla. She was a supposed defector from the Sabbat, but had in fact remained in alliance with them to destroy the local Camarilla.
Aurora Golden is a Cult of Ecstasy mage and member of the Black Pyramid Chantry in Las Vegas.
Aurora Rosselini is a Hecata neonate from Montreal. She was pushed to the brink of death by a Wraith before being saved to be turned into a Kindred and pursuing revenge.
Ashanti Beachum is a koldun and the Tzimisce priest of the Chalice of Osseous Delights pack, currently based in Atlanta.
Baalphegor, the King of Gluttony or Sa'asu-Nihur, is the lord of addicts and one of the nine maeljin.
Badr was an 8th generation Lasombra, the Sultan of Granada, during the Dark Ages.
Baron Fairweather, the manifestation of the Title Cloistered Baron of Impossible Dreams, seeks the conquest of the mortal world.
Ayanda is a Mekhet, embraced into a strange and esoteric variant of undeath known to no other Kindred, aside from her sire.

Avery is a ninth generation Nosferatu and the first childe of Lawrence Meeks. Trained by his sire, she was an agent of the local Nosferatu intelligence network, Embraced to replace the network's reliability on vampires of different clans.
Barbara, known as Barb, is Rook's Ghoul and Dimitri Pack's thrall.
Barnes is a Toreador Archon of the Camarilla, serving in modern times.
Basilio Radovan is a Ventrue Archon of the Camarilla, serving around the 1930s.
Azhvin is a Faustian Devil in Los Angeles. Azhvin is possessing the body of a mortal known as Micky Aldin.
Azhi and Dahaki are Devourers in Los Angeles. Azhi and Dahaki are possessing the bodies of twin mortals known as Bric-et-Brac (Daniel Montague and Danielle Montague).

Barnabus is a sixth generation Assamite of the Vizier Caste, and sire of Ahmed ibn Zayyat. He Embraced Ahmed for sharing similar moderate religious views in the time of the religious crusades across the Levant. After training him in Tripoli, Lebanon, he sent his childe on a final test to steal a special artifact and slay its guards. Ahmed was transformed by this experience and became a devout Christian, and later the Prince of the city.
Bashemath is a Slayer in Los Angeles. Bashemath is possessing the body of a mortal known as Peter Gold.
Barak is a Slayer in Los Angeles. Barak is possessing the body of a mortal known as Raul Lopez.
Azalan is a renegade Fiend in Los Angeles. Azalan is possessing the body of a mortal known as Mike Shaughnessy.
Avis Malone is an Order of Hermes Master Mage of the Fraternal Society of Bonisagus Cabal of Doissetep.
Baghatur Kazharin is a Tremere alchemist of the Dark Ages. He was part of the coterie put together by Jervais to enter Livonia and destroy the Telyavelic Tremere.
Avery Fellowes is an Hierach wraith and Premier Scout of the Emerald Legion.
Bennu is a Silent Strider. In late 1998, Bennu becomes the first of her tribe to contact ancestors since the Diaspora.
Beomedian Khulud, also known simply the Vulture, is the vampiric overlord over the criminal scene in Cairo.
Bianca de Genève was a Follower of Set active during the Dark Ages.
The Bay't Mutasharid are the Arabic Nosferatu and those associated with the Ashirra sect.
Princess Bethany is a Seelie Sidhe Wilder of House Gwydion in Hibernia.
Bernhardt Mueller is a German mage, a member of the Sons of Ether who goes by "Dr. Comet." He predicted the existence of the comet Mirzaba, and its apocalyptic consequences for the Tellurian.
Beth Malcolm is an eighth-generation Ventrue and political manipulator within the Camarilla.

Benedict Hutter is a Caitiff ancillae and leader of the Bloodless Pilgrims. The cult has been traveling since its inception, but recent events have left Kindred society in chaos, with whole cities ripe for the taking. If Hutter can gain a foothold in a region upset by the Second Inquisition or the Anarch rebellion, he’s grown strong enough on the Blood of his supplicants to take and hold a throne of his own. This could also give him access to stronger victims, allowing him to enhance his Blood Potency and gain even more power.
Belet-Iri is a Scourge in Los Angeles. Belet-Iri is possessing the body of a mortal known as Naadira Awad.
Bekhorata is a Malefactor in Los Angeles. Bekhorata is possessing the body of a mortal known as Indira Gunaratnam.
Bettie Dyandra is a Euthanatos mage and member of the Black Pyramid Chantry in Las Vegas.
Benjamin Rufford is a powerful eighth generation Tremere and the Regent of Dhahran, in Saudi Arabia. He resides in the city with a few other foreign Ashirra.
Berdrand Ostek is a tenth generation Tremere and the sire of Searcy Whithul.
Benedict is an influential Ventrue and crime lord of the London Camarilla.
Bitiurges was once a mage of House Tremere and later part of Clan Tremere.
Blood Aspect Liminal Exalted are created by those motivated by lust, greed, ambition, or similarly possessive emotions. They embody wellsprings of passion and are vessels of binding forces.
Black Nathaniel is an angel focused on the capture of ghosts.
Black Tarn is a Black Fury theurge and a former member of Clay's pack.
Blake is a vampire neonate of New York and the childe of Ophelia.

They respond as one. The Blood Sisters are a couple of Camarilla enforcers at the court of Prince Martin Hilkers. They have the ability to share damage between them, probably through the use of the Sanguinus Discipline. They also fight as a team in Jimmy Smythe’s arena at The Hollow.
Boris Ivanovich Kuschena is a Shadow Lord. He arrived in Australia in the summer of 1826. He was the first Shadow Lord to do so.
Bodor Toth also known as Magib, was a seventh generation Tzimisce, and childe of Zubor.
The Boscage is a hobgoblin that might best be described as an elemental creature made out of the Hedge.
==Overview== A sorcerer who practices voudoun for purely personal gain.
The Bride of Night is a Fifth Generation generation Lasombra and the Patrician of Rome in the 13th century.
Bosche Singh was the Gangrel Primogen of the Twin Cities. He was among those Kindred destroyed in the 2021 attack by the Mortician's Army.
The Bonewitch is a Wyrm creature, most likely a fomor or Black Spiral Dancer, with a penchant for leaving Stolen Moons in her wake.
Bosatsu is a Fiend in Los Angeles. Bosatsu is possessing a mortal known as Hannah Klein.

Boleslav Volhyny is a powerful Tzimisce Voivode of the Carpathians during the Dark Ages. He is a friend of Myca Vykos. During the Omen War, he captured a Tremere ghoul named Stephen spying his lands and brought him into his castle to meet his childer and torture him for information. Being an old vampire, he states that Tremere blood smells exactly like a Tzimisce's, due to their transformation ritual, and can recognize it easily.
Brian Mitchell is a Syndicate mage and member of the Cloud Room Construct in Las Vegas.
Buddy is a Dog-Spirit possessing a dog and is wearing a collar Locus.
Cries in the Wind is a Lupus Ahroun Wendigo. He was born in 1932.

.]] Courtney Harper is a teenage Ananasi girl who undergoes her First Change in the introductory comic in Breedbook: Ananasi. The story shows how a young werespider's emotions gradually flatten or vanish before their change. It also implies that she eats, or at least exsanguinates, her human mother at the end.
Cælestius was an influential theologian in early Christianity whose teachings were declared heretical. Unknown to many, he was also a vampire desperate for papal blessing.
Crocetta Giovanni was the Prince of Havana during the 1950s and 1960s. She was known for being the first Giovanni Prince in the Americas and the first female Giovanni prince to ever hold Praxis.

Curtis is a traumatized teenager and the epicenter of a dead spot on Lucky Lane. Currently living with his mother, Curtis's abusive stepfather lived with them until Curtis killed him. The trauma of the event drove the creation of the aforementioned dead spot. Now, the teenager spends his time attending to his mother, who suffered from a nervous breakdown after the incident.
Crosses-the-River was a Wendigo Ahroun who sacrificed himself against the Storm Eater.
The Coyote Trio are a Mexican cell of former Hunters who have since abandoned that path in life to become supernatural [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Coyote_(person) coyotes] - hence the new name.

Crawford was a vampire emissary assigned by the Toreador elder Victoria Ash to steal a thaumaturgical formula from the Hartford Chantry. Crawford was able to retrieve the formula but was destroyed in the escape.
Provost Crevel is a ninth generation Nosferatu in the Fief of the North.
Darklings are one of the changeling seemings. They are the nocturnals, the fae that lurk in the shadows and call from lightless grottoes and hidden glens.
Dale Beecher was a ghoul alchemist living in Seattle, and a friend of the Malkavian detective Fabien. He was killed by the Rebar Killer (possibly the Seattle Sabbat) in modern nights.
Father Dakarai Morley is a Mage of the Celestial Chorus in Wales.
Dajan Siaka is a ninth generation Tremere and Primogen of Boston.
Danny Kimball is a Vampire. Quote: Put down the stake and maybe we can answer both our questions.
Dalukmatia is a Fiend in Los Angeles. Dalukmatia is possessing a mortal known as Marianne Northcott.
Datura was a 6th generation Ventrue, Prince of the city of Veracruz, Mexico.
Dearbhal ni Ruadh Dara is an Unseelie Sidhe of House Daireann.
David Braughn is an eight-year-old boy who is too aware of the Shadow for his own comfort.

Jack Deacon was, in his Second Life, an unrepentant skinhead with a drug addiction before he was killed in a gang drive-by. In death he was approached by the tem-akh of an artist. In his Third Life as an Amenti, Deacon Jack was reborn as a Kher-minu, a reformed tattoo artist bestowing his art with magical properties.

Daryl Roy was a Toreador of Montreal. He, along with his clanmates Talia Lehrer and Philippe Ducharme are kidnapped by a mysterious party in the city, prompting an Elysium emergency meeting by the Camarilla. It is later revealed that he was diablerized by the Sabbat and a message was carved into his chest as a threat to the Montreal Camarilla.
Delgado was a Lasombra elder of the Dark Ages. The younger Lasombra Ibrahim feared Delgado would destroy him if he rebelled against the Clan's leadership.
Demtius is a fifth generation Malkavian and the sire of Gregorius Dimities. Working for the Inconnu, he manipulated his childe and assisted in the destruction of the Dream of Constantinople.

del Georgio Giovanni is a seventh generation Giovanni elder and the sire of the infamous Genevra. He is a senile and old vampire of Italy, who was manipulated by Genevra into Embracing her, after she eliminated his own wife, Carmina, in secret.
DeWinter is a powerful Malkavian elder and the leader of the Toronto Camarilla remnants.
A Demon of Iron and Violence is a cyborg that serves Mikaboshi's will in his Wicked City.
Denelem Obfusco is an influential tenth generation Tremere of Jerusalem.
Dieter Kotlar is a 7th generation Nazi Brujah, member of the Final Reich gang. He was a Primogen of Berlin under the rule of Gustav Breidenstein. After Gustav's demise, his whereabouts are unknown.

Doctor Lhotsky was a Shadow Lord. In 1832 he lead an expedition into Wadbilliga. He attempted to contact the Bunyip using aboriginal translators, but the attempt failed. Lhotsky killed the translators in anger, blaming them for the failure, and he was in turn killed by Bunyip.
A Diabolus (plural Diaboli) is a creature of Twilight that has become corrupted by the forces of Hell.
David Frankel is a Nosferatu that is the sole vampiric inhabitor of the Swiss city of Basel.
Djhowtey was an Awakened mage active circa 2500 BCE. He, along with his wife Sesheta, is considered one of the founders of the Order of Hermes.
Dion is an Iku Eshu Wilder and sometime member of the Shadow Court.
Lord Dillon is a Sidhe Wilder of House Fiona in the Kingdom of Apples.
Dha-shi-zhi, "The Maiden of Flowers" was a Homid Stargazer Ragabash and part of the First Jade Sentai.
Dixan Chenilly is a Sandmen Wraith and a specialist in Oneiric Pacing.
Dmitri Karolev was a tenth generation Toreador and the sire of Angelique Stravinsky.
Desiree Traville is a Lasombra and the pack leader of The Ravens, a politically motivated coven in the Sabbat.
Dr. Douglas Netchurch is a vampire of the Malkavian clan, well-known worldwide as an expert on vampire physiology.
Don Ibrahim of Marrakesh was a Lasombra Archbishop within the Sabbat, who enjoyed playing chess with living pieces, be they Kindred or Kine.
Donovan is a Seelie Sidhe Wilder and High Lord of House Dougal.
Field Commander Doireannara (aka Doireann ni Leachlainn) is an Unseelie Sidhe Wilder of House Ailil in Hibernia.
Douglas "Boss" Callihan was the Anarch Baron of New York City.

A pale, white-haired beauty, Doomwise is the shadow-touched oracle of the werewolves of Colorado. Unlike almost every other werewolf there is, she was raised with foreknowledge of her true nature. Her mother, a powerful seer, foresaw that her daughter would be a werewolf, and Doomwise was raised in preparation for her role from birth. This has left her without much of the cultural baggage borne by other werewolves, but also without much empathy. She sees humans as distant relatives and eschews most contact with them. Her visions of death and disaster have proven stunningly accurate, giving her words a fearsome weight that further isolates her from her fellow werewolves. For all that, Doomwis
Dream Maker(s) are Banes that are similar to genies and grant wishes to humans.
Donny Sheridan is an eleventh-generation Brujah and Anarch ancilla.
Dominique Rodriguez is an autarkis ancilla (based on her Disciplines and general disposition, most likely a Hecata of Cappadocian descent) inhabiting Bellium University.
Dresmiel is a Defiler in Los Angeles. Dresmiel is possessing the body of a mortal known as Sly Jones.
Donald Richardson is a New World Order mage (1847 - present).
Dorje Washington is a New World Order mage. He is the leader of the "Jesuits."
A Dream Hunter is a monster inhabiting the depths of Mnesis, a dream of terror come alive.
The Dux Bellorum, also known as an Imperator, is the warlord of the Camarilla.
The Duchess of Amber was a powerful Ventrue childe of Mithras, the Cainite Prince of London.
Dylan ap Morgan is a Seelie Sidhe Wilder of House Gwydion and ruler of the Principality of Dyfed in Cymru.
Earl Deams was an Imbued and user of hunter-net, where his username was Shaka74. He was a former military photographer from New Orleans. He is presumed dead.

Edith Beaubien is a Nosferatu who runs the Painted Lady and she is currently ignorant of the power the slumbering Ancestor possesses, but she wishes to know more. At this time, Edith acts as the herald to something all Kindred but her would deem nightmarish.

Edward Whitman, also called Grimmaulkin, was a Blightbent Elemental who resided in Victorian London. Even after his escape from his Keeper's Arcadian production factory, Whitman's life remained a tragic one. Suffering from prejudice due to his kith, Whitman was blamed for the poisoning of a public well and executed without trial by his fellow Lost. It was later learned that he was entirely uninvolved, and that the poisoning was the work of a local dye mill.

The Dying Priest is Maeltinet under the service of Mammon. The Dying Priest fulfils many functions, but chief among these is that of a cult leader. This Maeltinet incarnation appears as an emaciated young man, gray-skinned with a death's head grin and golden teeth. It is also known that the Greater Jaggling's joints click and crack with every movement. Sometimes the being disguises its appearance when performing sermons for its cultists. Sometimes it does not.
Duncan Bessemer is a Renegade of the Artificer Guild who soulforges the hapless wraiths of celebrities and politicians.
Dyabhan is a Scourge in Los Angeles. Dyabhan is possessing the body of a mortal known as Juan Alejandro.
Ebisu is a Malefactor in Los Angeles. Ebisu is possessing the body of a mortal known as Nathaniel Hidalgo.

A Dust Man is an Infernal Host from Infernalism: The Path of Screams. These otherworldly creatures have a few demonic powers or Charms. They can also be taken as familiars by infernalists and diabolists through the Familiar Background.
Dyubbiel was an Earthbound Devil who controlled the Skin-eaters cult in Persepolis.

Elim of the Fierce Ones was a Fianna Garou who battled Cinvortrix of the Hounds of the Horned One for the high kingship of Tara (WTA). Elim won, and proclaimed himself to be Ard Righ or high king of all the Fianna, although this claim was not be recognized by most Fianna outside of Ireland for some time.
Ellison Humboldt is an influential sixth generation Nosferatu of Berlin.
Empress Aliara, also known as the Countess Desire, is the Maeljin Incarna of Karnala, the Urge Wyrm of Desire.
Elif Parmak is a vampire in Seattle. She is a Tremere, the representative of one of the factions in the city, and the right hand of Viktor Goga, the leader of The Newcomers.
Eleanor Worthing was a changeling serial killer and member of the Peerage in Victorian London.
Lady Eloise Marchand was a Ventrue living in the Fief of York during the 13th century.
Elisabet O'Donal is an Messianic Voice Mage from the British Isles during the Dark Ages.
Emmanuel Rudesi was a Lasombra elder who was destroyed by his childer, including Niccolo, at some point in time.
Emily Harden is a Verbena Mage living in the woods of Research Plantation #4.
Elizabeth Bharati is a Euthanatos mage of the Political Triage International Cabal.
Elaiodora Sophida is a Tzimisce Scholarch of Constantinople.

An Eunuch is a wraith that has been stripped of their will and now basically serves as a living notepad for the Four Magistrates, as paper and the like are extremely rare in the Shadowlands. By command, a Eunuch is able to recite every piece of information stored within them.
Enver Frasheri is a rather notorious Toreador. He is a revenge artist who specializes himself on breaking a person in the most effective and devastating way.
Evelyn Marlowe, known to her packmates as Sister Evelyn, is a Ventrue antitribu of the 12th generation. She is the pack priest of Les Orphelins, a coven in in Montréal.

Eve Forgus is a young Beast (likely a Makara Ravager) in the seventh grade. She struggles with behavioral problems in her new school, but befriends Richard Fries when she realizes he is also a Beast. Eve habitually wears a hoodie with the hood pulled up and tightened around her face, in defiance of the school dress code.
Eugenio Estevez, also known as Genie, is the Tremere Regent of the Maupassant Room chantry in New York City.
Erianthe, known as the Oracle of Knossos, is Malkavian of the 7th generation.
Erebus was [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bath,_Somerset Bath’s] Ninth generation Cappadocian Augur during dark ages.

Everett Greene was a Tremere neonate of the Hartford Chantry. He has extensive experience with thaumaturgy and feeds only from blood banks. He keeps his mortal family and his work as a research chemist. Not long after his embrace, he is sacrificed by Regent Deneb Osborne.
Eurydice, Chosen of Apophis is a corrupted Wraith in the service of Apophis.
Eugene Smith is a ghoul. Quote: "Sorry, this section's closed to the public. Come back tomorrow."
The Everlite Drone was a Weaver-possessed individual operating in the Pioneer Valley and seeking to turn the efforts of Everlite Gas & Electric to serve the ends of the Weaver.

Enrico Guiccardini is a ninth generation Lasombra and the sire of Giacomo Guiccardini. Giacomo was responsible for killing the mortal son of Enrico through crafstmanship, and this made Enrico see him as worthy of the Embrace.
Erazil is a Cryptic Devil in Los Angeles. Erazil is possessing the body of a mortal known as Harold Martin.
Eugene is the Tremere Primogen of the domain of Prince Cyprian.
Estaban Vasquez is a tenth generation Nosferatu antitribu and a Ductus of the Sabbat. He embraced the young hacker Malloc in Tijuana.
Ermenegildo is a ninth generation Lasombra of the Black Hand, and the sire of Percival.
Brother Everard de Gascony was a member of the Order of St. Theodosius who learned the language of the Fae.
Eulogio Sanchez de los Reyes is a Tremere antitribu of the Sabbat.
Eusabius Siculus is a Fisher Death bishop and the ruler of Necropolis San Juan.

Comtessa Esclamonte von Padua is a Lasombra of the Dark Ages. She serves as an envoy of the Lombard League of Cities, sent to the Holy Roman Empire by Clan Lasombra to investigate threats to the clan.
Father Wolf, sometimes also referred to as Mother Wolf or, more correctly, by his First Tongue name Urfarah, was the Pangaean god of the hunt and one of the ancestors of the Uratha.

Federico di Padua, also known as the Right Hand of the Camarilla, has been an Archon since the foundation of the Camarilla (by that time he was spontaneously Blood bound to his fellow Jean-Marc d'Harfleur). He is regarded as one of the deadliest warriors of the sect.
Eyes-of-Crystal is a metis theurge Child of Gaia cub. She appears in Rage.
Fakir Al Sidi is the legendary progenitor of the Laibon vampires of the African continent.

The example Occultist Earthbound Thrall from the Demon: The Fallen core book.Not for the first time, Father Sean Riordan reflected that he was damned. But as he inspected the Liber Malictorium — a tome of blasphemous knowledge his master required — and thought of the terrible wisdom he could learn from the book of demonology, he decided he didn’t give a fuck about his damnation.Not when he had the chance to gain power instead.– the flavor text accompanying Father Sean Riordan, edited for brevity.
Felix Lodz is the last Tremere serving the Camarilla in the Atlantic City Chantry.
Faye Renfew was a twelfth generation Brujah of London and the sire of Derek Jacobson.

Fireclaw is a male Theurge Red Talon. Originally from Alaska, he has recently led Red Talons into Las Vegas in an effort to root out Wyrm taint. While there he attacks one of the Ragnarok Casino Employees and ends up in a fight with Moe Stimple.

Fexia is a 12th generation Nosferatu antitribu from Mexico City. A crusader of the Sabbat Inquisition in both action and religious belief, she recently arrived at Montréal to help her ally Mercy by joining the Talons pack.
Fergus Shaughnessy, also known as Fenarius, is a fox Pooka Wilder and founder of the Commoners' Liberation Organization.
The Fiend of Ennui and Exuberance is a Strix enamored with the act of possession and the experiences it brings.
Florentina Conti is a Hecata of Milan, missing in recent nights. Her clan is looking for the responsible party, at the same time as they plot the downfall of Prince Prospero.
Ferdinand d'Amico was an Inquisitor of the Sabbat. He first invoked the Ritual of the Severed Hand in the late 1800s and was killed immediately afterward by the ritual.
Fyodor is a character from the Hunter: The Reckoning series. He is a Visionary and is the Author of Apocrypha.

Gabriel de Cambrai is an elder Toreador whose artistic focus is making infernalists produce genuinely pleasing screams. He is the founder of the Order of the Star of Morning and a walker of the Via Adversarius.
G'louogh, the "Dance of Corruption", is a totem spirit of the Wyrm.
Gadiel is an Unseelie Sidhe Wilder of House Balor in the Kingdom of Willows.
Frank Weisshadel is a typical Tremere looking for ways to become a more powerful wizard.
Francisco Vasquez is a Halimaw whose human and Supernatural identities are entirely unaware of one another.
Francis the Confessor is a Bone Shadow Elodoth member of the Lodge of Doors.

Frondator was a French Tremere and Goratrix's lieutenant in the Paris Chantry during the Dark Medieval. As a member of House Goratrix, she became a de facto member of the Tremere antitribu after their defection to the Sabbat. Her fate after the destruction of the Sabbat Tremere is unknown.
Fred is a Portal Guardian of the Progenitor EcoR Horizon Realm.

Francis Lambert is an influential Tremere and a first-circle Regent. He believed in testing the limits of blood sorcery and advancing internal trust among the Tremere. Eventually, Francis was accused of Infernalism, staked and locked with all his treasures in an undisclosed location. He was later found and his tomes were stolen by the old Tremere Sheila.
Fra' Raymond was a Nosferatu knight-priest of Constantinople and brood father of the St. Ladre Nosferatu.
GShen-rab is a Defiler in Los Angeles. GShen-rab is possessing the body of a mortal known as Tommy Yongchaiyut.
Francesca was a tenth generation hispanic Lasombra assassin and the childe of the powerful Mohammed Al-Muthlim.
George Frederick is a 8th generation Samedi and sire of Lithrac.
The Ganconer (Geancannah), also called the Love-Talker, is a creature of the Dreaming that feeds on those who love, being particularly fond of the Sidhe.
Gentleman John, also known as the Thistle Thief, is a changeling thief who targets the irreplaceable, leaving behind a thistle.
Professor Geoffrey Twidmarch is a Mage of House Merinita of the Order of Hermes. He was born in 1922.
Gentle Brook is a Children of Gaia Lupus Theurge from Chicago..
Gene "Cull" Coller is a Fire-Touched member of the Howl to Mock the Dead Pack in Colorado.
Gerti Eriksdottir is an Valdaermen Mage from Scandinavia during the Dark Ages. She is a member of the cabal at Ulf's Hall. She dies from an attack by the Bar Sinister Coterie.
Baron Geoffrey of Calais was a Ventrue overlord of the Norman Triumvirate who sought to conquer the British Isles during the Dark Ages.
Gavril is a Slayer in Los Angeles. Gavril is possessing the body of a mortal known as Fred Jacobs.
Sir Garland of Laramy was a former knight of the Knights Templar who became a Pagan Mage.
Gerhard Rohrich is the Nosferatu Sheriff of Prince Ursula Eisenstadt of Munich. He is native to the city.
Gem Ghastly is a Malkavian Primogen, who disguises as a Ventrue.
Gorman Stonefist is/was a theurge Get of Fenris who founded the Sept of Fafnir's Brood during World War II.
Gilgamesh was a Gangrel methuselah and king of Uruk in ancient Sumer.

Graham Fleming is a Tremere of the Hartford Chantry. He specializes in poison and serves as the bodyguard of Regent Deneb Osborne. He has a strong personal resentment towards Dajan Siaka. He is considered good man and loyal Tremere.
Gilbert Sinclair is a Storm Lord Cahalith member of the Skyfire pack in Chicago.
Grace Cunningham is a Mage. Quote: You'd best close the door before you let a chill in... or something gets out.

Gloria Flores, also known as Gums, is a Nosferatu with a deep appreciation for Nictuku worshippers, whom she values above all else. She tracks them down with zeal in the hope of becoming one of them. Her ultimate goal is to personally offer her sire as a sacrifice to their masters, and she is more than willing to sacrifice as many Nosferatu as necessary to achieve it.
Ginevra Salamanca is an independent ghoul who formed the Unmastered group in the 1950s, and became a member of its ruling Core. She was a former member of the Tzimisce Obertus.
Gnaeus is a sixth generation Ventrue of the Eternal Senate, and the sire of Junius.
Godfrey d'Auffay is a powerful Gangrel and the founder of the Knights of Avalon.

Grimgroth is a vampire of clan Tremere, and a member of the Tremere Inner Council of Seven. He is responsible for Western Europe including the British Isles and Australia. In life, he was a House Tremere magus of Mistridge covenant, which he betrayed.

Guilelmo Aliprando was a diplomat Embraced by the Cainite Prince of Venice during the Dark Ages. He acted as the voice of Prince Narses, but eventually became Prince of that city himself after the diablerie of his sire.
Lord Grodolf is an Unseelie Troll Wilder and member of House Balor.
Grandma Mara is a True Fae who spends her time fortunetelling.
Gunnhild, the "Mother of Kings" and Fiend-witch is a Nordic Tzimisce of great potency and age from Scandinavia.
Derek Kopell, more often known by his self-applied nickname Gunshop, is an American orphan Mage who has taken up an individual counter-crusade against Hunters in his area.

Lord Graythwaite is a ninth generation Tremere and the sire of Jean-Michel du Pont-Ville. He was an European nobleman who traveled to the Caribbean to get away from the oppressive influence of the Church in Europe and explore the possibilities of the supernatural in the region. He became a slave owner in Barbados where he ruled over a magnificent plantation. There he discovered the young west African slave Jean-Michel du Pont-Ville who practiced the local voodoo magic. After sending him to Europe to get proper education, he Embraced Jean-Michel.
Guanli is a Malefactor Minister of Lions of the Infernal Court in Los Angeles. Guanli is possessing the body of a mortal known as Jeremiah Azevedo.
Gregory Roiters is the Tremere Regent of Birmingham, Alabama.
Grandmother Penne is a Nosferatu elder of London, during the Medieval period.

Gregorio was a Lasombra lieutenant of Alfonzo of Venice. Serving during the Bitter Crusade against the Trinity, he and Marco lead the Lasombra forces to embrace the gladiators at the Hippodrome, to create an army for Alfonzo. He serves as Marco's bodyguard and uses his mastery of obtenebration to defend him from opponents. The armored Lasombra engage the St. Ladre Nosferatu and Malachite but are destroyed.

Harold Goodston, also known as Pariah, is one of a mere handful of Garou to survive the vampiric Embrace and become an Abomination. In life he was a Homid Galliard of the Silver Fangs tribe during the mid-19th century.
Harold Zettler is a vampire, a Malkavian antitribu who is on the Board of Directors of Pentex. He is quiet, but cruel and depraved, almost zealous. He sired Persephone Tar-Anis in 1845.
Gülcan Ostadasadli is an Assamite Sorceress and an acquaintance of Rutor, a Tremere involved in the Conspiracy of the Red Sign.
Harry Reese is a Gangrel antitribu of the 8th generation. He is the ductus of The Dead Gypsies pack.
Gwyedd is a powerful Gangrel of the 5th generation who roams the country parks of Hong Kong.
H'rugg, the Essence of Sludge, is an elemental spirit of the Wyrm.

Hafsa is an eighth generation Banu Haqim. She was once an Archon for Madame Guil after leaving the clan in the early 20th century, acting as one of Guil's foremost information gathers. Now, she serves Juliet Parr, Justicar of Clan Malkavian, monitoring the Kindred of London.
Guðrunn was a Fifth Generation Cappadocian, Bjarkarey’s Court Völva.
Hassan Al-Nasir is an Ahl-i-Batin Mage from the British Isles during the Dark Ages.
Harut is a Devil in Los Angeles. Harut is possessing the body of a mortal known as John Park.
Had'adezur is a Malefactor in Los Angeles. Had'adezur is possessing the body of a mortal known as Jenna Squires.
Hamath-Zobah is a Malefactor in Los Angeles. Hamath-Zobah is possessing the body of a mortal known as Dan Stegman.
Haksedian is a Fiend in Los Angeles. Haksedian is possessing a mortal known as Gary Maros.
Haurvatat is a Defiler in Los Angeles. Haurvatat is possessing the body of a mortal known as Carlos Reyes.
Haraphael is a Slayer in Los Angeles. Haraphael is possessing the body of a mortal known as Trip-9.

Hallstedt is a Fifth Generation Tremere Pontifex and the sire of Patricia von Bernstein. After centuries of mentorship, he assigned his childe Patricia to Frankfurt, after the local Ley lines showed signs of disruption.
Hauzal is a fifth generation Nosferatu of the Holy Lands, and the sire of Dondinni.
Doktor Hans von Rottenfeld is a Hippocratic Circle mage who founded the Brandenburg Krankenhaus.

Hakahe is the Incarna of Vulcan, and is credited with forging the souls of newborn Garou. Modern scientists and other humans have stopped believing in Vulcan, the planet closer to the sun than Mercury.
The Hieromagus is a mage Guardians believe will one day appear, lead the Pentacle in defeating the Exarchs and re-establish Atlantis.
Hides-in-Bright-Sun was a Ragabash Red Talon who lived during the Dark Ages. He regularly communicates with his Ancestor Spirit, Teeth-Split-Bone.
Herschel Salomon was a Nosferatu rabbi with the desire to protect the Jewish people even in undeath.
Heshon, was a former goddess of Luck, in the Long-lost Atlantean Pantheon .

An inhabitant of Egypt during the time of the Web of Seven, Heliodoros was, following in his father’s footsteps, a priest of Alexander, the once-living god. As a priest, Heliodoros had access to a great many luxuries, including a variety of occult texts that had been taken in conquest. The priest would steal away to the library in the night, when he could be certain he was alone, so as to study the texts, with the intention of eventually testing those occult arts.

Hermione was a Qashmal who, during the time of the Web of Seven, forgot her identity and, in her forgetfulness, took on the identity of a Goblin Queen. In that position, she used a variety of tokens to power Contracts made with her.
Hernan Bolivar is a Blood Talon Irraka member of the Lodge of Quetzal.

Doctor Henry Banerjee is an eleventh generation Hecata and a Herald of the Sun, a vessel of Mithras's will. He is a playable character in the sourcebook Fall of London. He was of Indian origin and worked as a mortal at Guy's Hospital, in London.
Hiaken is a Devourer in Los Angeles. Hiaken is possessing the body of a mortal known as Robin Jang.
Hirguan is a Annunaki. He is possessing the body of a mortal known as Darryl Sykes.

Hector Wilson was a powerful eleventh generation Lasombra and a Sabbat Bishop of New York City. In the city he Embraced Clova Haines and there he was destroyed during the Battle of New York with the Camarilla.
Hiram, the Master Scribe is a Hierarch wraith of the Grim Legion.
Helen Drake is tenth generation Ventrue in The Fief of the Normandy.
Helen Lloyd is a thirteenth generation Ventrue and an insurance racketeer of the London Camarilla.
Horace Radcliffe, better known as Radcliffe with Teeth, is a Nosferatu who was active in New York City during the late 19th and early 20th centuries.
Masters are the most powerful elders of the Hollow Ones: a "Tradition" of the Council of Nine Mystic Traditions.
Horrorspawn are autonomous pieces of a Beast's Horror, capable of acting somewhat independently.
Hope is a Malkavian and information broker from New York City.
The Hounds are supernatural creatures of an unknown nature, seemingly summoned by blood rituals. In keeping with that theme, they seem to hunt by the scent of blood.
